title: Mirror-compressed AdapterFusion source bank
hypothesis: One shared adapter matrix plus a small per-source Givens coordinate can retain useful multi-source target fusion quality with fewer serialized bytes than a full AdapterFusion bank, and outperform an equal-byte direct scalar source code.
physical_object: one shared 16x16 source adapter basis versus four independently trained source adapters
mirror_coordinate: one Givens angle per source adapter, conjugating the shared matrix by a 16D channel rotation
logical_multiplicity: four source-task adapter functions fused into four target-task functions

model.data: Synthetic linear feature-task bank. Four independent random source matrices define frozen source adapters; four target matrices are fixed mixtures of them. Train source adapter fit plus target fusion coefficients jointly on train examples; validate/test on new examples.

controls: AdapterFusion reference: four independent source adapter matrices plus learned target fusion coefficients; all bytes charged
one shared source adapter matrix with one direct scalar per source task
one shared source adapter matrix with one Givens angle per source task
hard-shared source adapter with no source code
development_gate_before_fresh: Both development seeds: independent bank target-test MSE <0.02; Mirror mean target-test MSE no more than 1.10x independent and no more than 1.05x scalar; Mirror actual payload <=0.60x independent and <=1.10x scalar-code payload; source-task MSE finite; target fusion coefficients and adapter source errors reported. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh seeds satisfy quality and byte gates; Mirror improves quality/byte frontier over scalar control or independent AdapterFusion while reporting compute/runtime; exact payload reload/replay.
failure_gate: Mirror target MSE exceeds 1.10x independent or 1.05x scalar in both development worlds, or byte gate fails.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: all independent adapters or shared basis
all Mirror angles or direct scalar source codes
task/path indices, metadata, and archive headers

boundaries: synthetic linear task-composition screen only; no NLP or AdapterFusion benchmark claim
target mixtures are held fixed across methods and are not counted as Mirror-created tasks
parameter count is secondary; serialized payload bytes are authoritative
fixed-update results are learning-efficiency evidence, not near-converged capacity
fresh seeds remain sealed until the full development gate passes
